scenes.heading: Counting in three
lines: This is called 3/4 time, or waltz time.
Let your body follow the rhythm — it feels natural once you move with it.
Let's try a simple waltz pattern: three even downstrums per bar.
Play along with the metronome at 80 bpm, and switch between G and D chords as the lights show.
Waltz time is all about counting 1-2-3 and letting the rhythm carry you.
Play along now — the app is listening.
